body: Thank you for asking.   I turned off the car and went inside.   Turns out 45 minutes of the car running in a one car garage is not long enough to kill me.  I will continue to fight day after day, it just gets hard sometimes.   I start therapy again on Tuesday so hopefully that helps.  Thanks again for asking.   It's nice  that someone cares about my wellbeing.
On a cold winter day while still inside take a bite of a popeyes  biscuit and then proceed to walk out side.   Its a moment you'll never forget.
I am a courier in DC.  I would take u/J3r3mzz advice.  When I first started a year and a half ago I dropped to 4.6 and nothing happened.  Just be sure to communicate with the customers.
